header.title: Developer Roles
header.subtitle: I work across frontend, backend, and mobile product development, with a current focus on senior frontend engineering.

0.title: Frontend Developer
0.description: Build responsive, accessible interfaces and reusable components that help product teams deliver consistent user workflows.

highlights.0: Develop web applications with clear component boundaries and maintainable state.
highlights.1: Connect interfaces to APIs with validation and useful loading, empty, and error states.
highlights.2: Collaborate on frontend architecture, code quality, and shared UI patterns.

1.title: Backend Developer
1.description: Build API services with clear contracts, secure authentication, reliable persistence, and practical deployment workflows.

highlights.0: Design REST APIs and separate transport, application, and data concerns.
highlights.1: Work with authentication, validation, relational databases, and caching.
highlights.2: Document setup and release steps so services are easier to run and maintain.

2.title: Mobile Developer
2.description: Develop mobile product features across Flutter and Android, including platform integrations and production app workflows.

highlights.0: Build cross-platform interfaces and connect them to backend services.
highlights.1: Integrate authentication and device capabilities with platform-aware behavior.
highlights.2: Apply reusable architecture and localization to mobile product development.
